'''Kanara''' is an [[Aiel]] ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]''.

== Activities ==
She is guarding [[Rand]] when [[Nynaeve]] tries to [[Heal]] him of his madness.

== Trivia ==
* Kanara is named for Karen Clarke, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
